items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta/full launch; counsel_required for upstream Woot rights and jurisdictional privacy decisions. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access, authentication, endpoints, and rate limits, but not commercial/public redistribution, storage, derivatives, caching, display, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights; current public terms restrict collection and commercial use. Fleet compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown, including 20 banner/consent/GA4 findings and 4 privacy/terms findings. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and owner gates remain blocked. Exact decision: retain keep_private, do not approve go-live, do not send rights outreach, and reject the candidate plan's new production, preview, telemetry, research, spend, and queue admissions. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only where it adds no new data collection, credentials, permissions, dependencies, cross-site behavior, or unsupported claims.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Progress is 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. Source-rights evidence is documented but confirms access only; data-flow evidence is partial; consent/analytics evidence is partial; logs, vendor, and incident evidence remain open. No task is closed because completion evidence is missing. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle containing the repository/config data-flow and retention table, deployed consent/withdrawal capture, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, log-field/access inventory, vendor terms or DPA status, and incident/request procedures. Keep outreach unsent pending owner authorization and human counsel review.

Legal gate: preserve SearchWoot private exposure. Complete the existing read-only evidence bundle without changing production, enabling tracking, sending outreach, or adding integrations. Record source fields and rights limits, retention/deletion/correction/access behavior, consent and notification controls, GA4 settings, log fields and retention, vendor terms, and incident/request procedures. Escalate upstream redistribution rights and jurisdictional privacy questions to human counsel.
